title: Set exit_code unconditionally on TestResult in BEP

timeline.message: Set exit_code unconditionally on TestResult in BEP
timeline.author: Aaron Sky

timeline.body:
Fixes #25165

I hope I did this right. I am able to see the output in my repro on rules_apple (which I can share if required by code review). Let me know if there's anything I've overlooked!

It would be great to get this into 8.1.0 if possible.

The comment under `SpawnResult#exitCode()` notes that this value is only actually meaningful in certain circumstances. *But*, the new code is called only after a block that throws if `!spawnResult.setupSuccess()`. So this is actually correctly placed.

Can you just add a comment like `// spawnResult.exitCode() is always meaningful because this code only runs if spawnResult.setupSuccess()`?

Sorry for the delay - I was briefly locked out until I dig up my old security key and enrolled my latest key.

This looks good to me! Just one comment to clarify why the given code is correct (it's a bit subtle due to the overly permissive structure of the `SpawnResult` API)

timeline.author: Aaron Sky

timeline.body:
@michaeledgar Thank you for the review! Would you mind taking another look with the added code comment?

Also, and I know it's cutting it close, but do you think it would be safe to include this in 8.1.0? Or if not, do you have a thought on how soon it would be reasonable to release?

I do not have much insight into the state of the Bazel 8.1.0 release right now, but I can definitely push to have this included!

I'll merge this PR shortly.
